contracts.skills: Project-scoped skills/list and discovered opaque skillId for config/write. UI displays scope, native paths as text, dependencies and current enabled state; paths never become write params. Hook source/trust/managed state and handler description are read-only.
contracts.plugins: Native catalog and installed views, paged search, identity-selected detail. Install requires current previewHash and explicit content/policy/authentication review; unavailable policy disables install. Uninstall is explicit. Write success means accepted then reread, never tool-ready. Reconcile asks for native installed-plugin update. Marketplace source forms distinguish registered-project relative path and credential-free HTTPS Git; change intent is explicit.
contracts.apps: Native catalog, installed committed snapshot and tool details. Accessible/enabled/connected/callable states remain distinct. Catalog-provided links use safe http/https schemes and require user navigation; no automatic external authentication or tool calls.
contracts.configuration: settings/read includes effective values/origins/layers and managed requirements. Named controls submit only changed supported fields with captured userVersion. Masked values are never echoed in write. Concurrent version changes preserve input, require explicit comparison/rebase, and a separate save. Native model catalog supplies reasoning choices. Structured/deeper config remains read-only pending dedicated forms.
contracts.drafts: Unsent configuration edits remain in bounded in-memory project-scoped cache across modal/auth transitions. No config text or secrets are persisted to localStorage/sessionStorage. At 10 dirty project drafts, new editing is blocked rather than evicting unsent input.
contracts.features: Native paged feature catalog, lifecycle labels and managed locks. Deprecated/removed/managed flags cannot be toggled from UI. Policy-read errors or pending requirements disable mutation.
contracts.insights: Native memory status and explicit typed confirmation for global memory/reset; separate from context compression/history deletion. Account usage preserves null as unavailable, includes daily buckets; workspace messages and process/gauge diagnostics rendered as structured data.
contracts.delivery: All changes use durable Api mutations. Unresolved operations block another configuration action; own unknown operation has original-receipt query only. Accepted receipt triggers status read, never mutation retry. Global idle indicator requires no active threads/pending starts/terminal/subscription or uncertain/maintenance state; backend still owns admission.
